annotations.title: EQ-5D Value Set Reference & Impact Estimator

description: Look up EQ-5D value set characteristics (UK 3L, England 5L, new UK 5L 2026, NICE DSU mapping) or estimate the ICER/QALY impact of the new UK EQ-5D-5L value set for a given indication type. Cites Biz, Hernández Alava, Wailoo (2026) Value in Health. Use when user asks about NICE 5L transition, UK utility value sets, or impact on NICE STA submissions.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

action.description: 'lookup' returns a single value set; 'compare' returns all four side-by-side; 'estimate_impact' returns ICER/QALY change estimates for an indication type.

base_icer.description: Optional: current ICER to project forward under new UK 5L.

base_incremental_qaly.description: Optional: current incremental QALY gain to project forward under new UK 5L.

indication_type.description: Indication category (required for 'estimate_impact'). 'non_cancer_qol_only' = chronic QoL-only conditions (migraine, UC, atopic dermatitis, HS, plaque psoriasis) — sees the biggest ICER increase.

value_set.description: Value set id (required for 'lookup'). 'uk_5l_new' is the 2026 one under NICE consultation.

name: hta.utility
